title: Display and photo choices at the quilt show
titleZh: 拼布被展的展示與照片選擇

documents.title: Exhibit guide for volunteers
documents.text:
MAPLE ROW QUILT SHOW | Exhibit guide for volunteers

Quilts may be displayed flat on a padded table or hung on a rail. To hang one, slide the rail through the sleeve sewn onto the back of the quilt. If the sleeve is too narrow for the rail, use a padded table instead. Do not pin or clip anything to a quilt.

Make a display card for each quilt. To credit the maker by name on that card, check the maker’s show form. If they did not give permission for a name credit in the hall, print the entry number and quilt title only.

Permission to use a name on a display card does not carry over to the online gallery. In the gallery, use entry numbers in place of names. Post a photograph only if its maker approved online photography and no initials, signatures, or names are visible in the photograph.
documents.textZh:
楓樹街拼布被展｜展覽志工指南

拼布被可以平放在有軟墊的桌上展示，也可以掛在橫桿上。懸掛時，把橫桿穿入縫在拼布被背面的布套。如果布套太窄，穿不進橫桿，就改用有軟墊的桌子。不要用別針或夾子把任何東西固定在拼布被上。

每件拼布被都要做一張展卡。若要在展卡上署名，請先查看製作者的參展表。如果製作者沒有同意在展場署名，展卡只印參展編號及作品名稱。

同意在展卡署名，不代表也同意在線上展覽署名。線上展覽用參展編號代替姓名。只有在製作者同意將照片用於線上展覽，且照片中沒有可見的姓名縮寫、簽名或姓名時，才可張貼照片。

documents.title: Intake notes for two entries
documents.text:
To: Exhibit team
From: Ren, intake volunteer
Subject: Entries 17 and 42

17, Harbor Steps, by Tessa King. The sleeve opening is three centimeters wide. Tessa declined name credit on the hall card but approved photos for the online gallery. Her initials are sewn into the lower right corner of the quilt. The center panel has no text or initials.

42, Orchard Road, by Lin Bell. The sleeve opening is six centimeters wide. Lin approved name credit on the hall card but did not approve any online photos, even pictures that leave out her name. The quilt itself has no visible signature or initials.

Both quilts are here, and the permissions above are from the signed forms.
documents.textZh:
收件人：展覽團隊
寄件人：收件志工任
主旨：第 17 號與第 42 號作品

17 號，《港口階梯》，製作者為泰莎・金。背面布套開口寬三公分。泰莎不同意在展卡上署名，但同意把照片用於線上展覽。她的姓名縮寫縫在右下角，中央那塊拼布則沒有文字或姓名縮寫。

42 號，《果園路》，製作者為琳・貝爾。背面布套開口寬六公分。琳同意在展卡上署名，但不同意線上使用任何照片，即使照片沒有她的姓名也不行。作品本身沒有可見的簽名或姓名縮寫。

兩件作品都已送達，以上授權均依據已簽署的表單。

documents.title: Morning setup and photo note
documents.text:
The rail in the entrance hall fits sleeves at least five centimeters wide. The padded table by the window has room for one quilt. The other table is for filling out feedback cards; it is not padded. Please leave the chairs there even if no one is writing at the moment. Some visitors need to sit to fill out a card.

For the first online update, pick one photograph from the shots already taken. There is a full view of entry 17 with the lower right corner visible and a close-up of only its center panel. There is also a full view of entry 42. Keep the other photographs in the private event folder.
documents.textZh:
入口廳的橫桿適用於開口至少五公分寬的布套。窗邊有軟墊的桌子能放一件拼布被。另一張桌子沒有軟墊，是給訪客寫回饋卡用的。即使當下沒人在寫，也請保留那裡的椅子；有些訪客需要坐著填卡。

第一次更新線上展覽時，請從已拍好的照片中選一張。17 號有一張看得見右下角的全景照，另有一張只拍中央拼布的特寫。42 號也有一張全景照。其他照片請留在非公開的活動資料夾。
